answer: We formulate a mechanism where validators deposit dynamic opportunity-cost bonds gated by zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs to broadcast a valid validation signal. Partitioning collateral across K Sybil identities triggers a subgame-perfect slashing matrix whose superlinear loss creates an ocean of negative yield, rendering expected utility E[U] < 0. This capital barrier guarantees convergence to a strict Nash equilibrium where honest single-node staking stands unyielding as a juniper root against Sybil multiplication.
